history.summary: Local Shiva-Parvati (Shiv-Shakti) temple on Radha Rani Sinha Road beside Akashwani, Adampur, Bhagalpur (PIN 812001). A popular neighbourhood temple for daily worshippers, beautifully decorated during Sawan Somvar and Mahashivratri; devotees report strong mental peace within the premises. No construction date, builder or history found in any source - appears to be a modern local temple (verify). Identity kept distinct from a separate Shiv Shakti Mandir at Bariarpur on the Bhagalpur-Munger Road (about 38 km away), which is a different temple and not this row.

name: Shiv Shakti Mandir, Bhagalpur
town_description: Bhagalpur, the 'Silk City' of Bihar, sits on the southern bank of the Ganges and is one of the oldest cities of the Gangetic plain - ancient Champa/Champanagar was the capital of the Anga Mahajanapada. It is famous for its tussar silk industry, the Vikramshila Mahavihara ruins at Antichak nearby, and as the home of Tilka Manjhi, an early tribal freedom fighter.
